description: HOOK CHECK: a vision read of a short clip's opening (first 15 s): a hook score, what a viewer takes away in the first second, the predicted attention peak and drop, a per-second attention curve and the one fix. The curve is a prediction from the pictures and on-screen words, not a measurement, and the sound is not heard. Priced by length; dryRun returns it.

dryRun.description: price only: nothing read, nothing charged

expected_credits.description: the get_cost price; refused unbilled if the live price differs

get_cost.description: true: return the price only; nothing runs or bills

idempotency_key.description: chosen once, resent unchanged on retries: the same key never buys twice

url.description: the video: a file URL, a post link, a Library id or a local path on the CLI

name: check_hook
title: Check a video’s hook
